mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 315.0 signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST growth above 1300 and RSAFS expansion beyond 700000 indicate robust consumer demand, driving earnings momentum and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when both HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 700000, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 4.0% with rising trend signals labor market overheating, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and rising, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained HOUST trend above 1350 consistently reflects housing market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate revenue growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST > 1350, or baseline Rank IC < 0.03.
